audience: tour operators and activity companies that manage tours, departures and bookings in TourCMS

useCases.title: Find tours with space for a group
useCases.text: Search the tours by keyword or month, then check the availability of one tour for a date and a group size.

useCases.title: Review the departures of one day
useCases.text: List the departures of all tours for one date, then open one departure to see its spaces and prices.

useCases.title: Reconcile payments for a period
useCases.text: List the payments recorded in a period, then open a booking to see its components and payments.

useCases.title: Review bookings and enquiries of a period
useCases.text: Search the bookings made in a period, and search the enquiries that came in during the same period.

useCases.title: Add a note to a booking
useCases.text: Add a note to an existing booking, such as a guest's request. The note does not change the booking.
